register.labelZh: COME IN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: COME IN Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: come in 可以描述潮水湧向岸邊,並逐漸覆蓋更多沙灘。；當某人進入房間或員工到辦公室時,都可以使用 COME IN。；come in with somebody on something 可以用來談論一起出錢購買禮物或其他物品。；come in for 可以表示受到批評;come into 則可以表示某事物出現在眼前、開始使用或生效。
register.summaryEn: COME IN can describe the tide moving towards the shore and covering more of the beach. You can use COME IN when someone enters a room and when a worker goes to the office. COME IN WITH SOMEBODY ON SOMETHING helps you discuss buying a present or another item together. COME IN FOR can describe receiving criticism, while COME INTO can describe something becoming visible, starting to be used or taking effect.
